narrative_md:
## Audit summary (illustrative example)

Baseline for the suite: 55,400 kWh of electricity and 2,500 kWh of gas a year, about $12,338 (range $9,867 to $15,633). Electricity is on LADWP with net metering; the prices in this example are illustrative.

Within the $25,000 budget the plan selects desk placement, the LED retrofit ($18,720) and a 1.72 kW rooftop array with the money left, for $24,482 upfront, saving about $4,434 a year (range $2,476 to $5,536). The LADWP lighting rebate is paid after installation and is not counted until its conditions are confirmed.

Air sealing does not fit the budget. A C-PACE scenario is shown for it, but it is hypothetical: no programme taking commercial applications in Los Angeles has been confirmed. Financed at $2,941 over 15 years the annual assessment would be $313. An assessment is a lien on the parcel until paid, collected with the property taxes.

No rooftop unit was confirmed, so unit replacement and an economizer were not evaluated; a tower like this is most likely on a central plant.

Value uplift: capitalised at the rates of 18 comparable sales, the plan's savings correspond to about $30,162 of property value (range $0 to $99,566). This is an estimate shown beside the totals; it is not added to the savings.
warnings: PV_ROOF may exceed budget at the high end of its cost range.
